description: Release a paused PERSON-reference run (lab_reference_motion with use_depth: 'personen') after the human has looked at its mask preview: this starts the paid model run. Until now only the mask was charged. Show the preview (metadata.personen_referenz_url of the paused clip) first — holes in hair or hands cost a full run if released. A NEW video row comes back; the paused row stays as the record of the mask. The backend refuses with a named reason (nicht_wartend, bereits_freigegeben) before anything is charged. Costs credits when called without get_cost.

get_cost.description: Preflight: return the price of the run WITHOUT starting it and without spending anything. Do this first and let the human confirm.

job_id.description: Alternatively the job id from lab_reference_motion's answer — resolved to its video row. Give this or video_id.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string.

video_id.description: Id of the PAUSED video row (from lab_reference_motion's answer or lab_job_status) — positive integer as string. Give this or job_id.
